Shraddha Kapoor to portray folk artist Vithabai in upcoming film 'Eetha'

The teaser for the upcoming film 'Eetha' has been released, featuring Shraddha Kapoor in the role of Vithabai, a renowned folk artist. The film appears to focus on Vithabai's life and performances, with the teaser highlighting an emotional and inspirational scene. Vithabai was known for her performances, having previously turned down a role in a Raj Kapoor film.
